doc.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Lydian book publication and marriage to Juanita
title: Marriage ending after the Lenox seminar
summary: The marriage began to break up around the Lenox School of Jazz when Juanita met Jimmy Giuffre.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: We married, I think it had to be in ’53, up until the – the next big event in my life was the School of Jazz.
That was at the end of the ’50s, ’58, ’59?
That was the start of us breaking up. She met Jimmy.
You were – I guess you had to relocate in order to do that.
I didn’t have to relocate. I could – we – this is after the seminar was over. We did relocate then, when I moved back to our house in Greenwich Village. She moved to a place uptown with Jimmy.
